description: Liquid Fuel Refineries is a data set deposited in Geoscience Australia by its authors Bauer C. (Bauer, C.). The Liquid Fuel Refineries Database presents the spatial locations; in point and polygon format, all known liquid fuel refineries within Australia. Coverage: national (AU); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: JSON, CSV, Excel, PDF. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
